allVisibleCapturedMeaning: true = every quest VISIBLE to this profile was captured, completed, active, failed, or listed-but-locked, across every tab the trader shows. profile.factionNote: USEC. DETERMINED FROM THE COLLECTION ITSELF, not something written down at capture time. Four quests are faction-exclusive with no counterpart id: Road Closed (USEC), Green Corridor (BEAR), Our Own Land (BEAR) and Counteraction (USEC). "Road Closed" is ACTIVE on this profile, and the wiki says outright that it is "only obtainable by USEC PMCs" with Green Corridor as its BEAR counterpart. Both BEAR-only quests are absent from Prapor's list, which was captured in full. A BEAR profile could not show Road Closed and would have to show the other two, so the reading is unambiguous.

quests.name: Gunsmith - MP-133
quests.lineShattered: THE GUNSMITH LINE, MAPPED IN FULL FROM THE GAME, 13 renames, the largest single set in this collection. Part 1 -> MP-133, 2 -> AKS-74U, 3 -> HK MP5, 4 -> OP-SKS, 5 -> Model 870, 6 -> AKM, 7 -> M4A1, 8 -> AKS-74N, 9 -> P226R, 10 -> AK-105, 11 -> Vector 9x19, 12 -> MPX, and then 15 -> AS VAL. Note the JUMP: parts 1-12 map in strict numerical order and then it skips to 15, so the numbering is NOT a reliable index into the weapon list. tarkov.dev publishes Gunsmith parts up to 25 plus 'Old Friend's Request', so 13 more remain unseen, most likely at LL4 or behind the ones still active.
objectives: Modify an MP-133 to comply with the given specifications

quests.name: Farming
quests.lineShattered: BREAKS THE PATTERN I HAD GENERALISED. Everywhere else the line HEAD keeps the base name. Operation Aquarius - Part 1 -> Operation Aquarius, Colleagues - Part 1 -> Colleagues, Vitamins - Part 1 -> Vitamins. Here the base name went to PART 3: tarkov.dev's 'Farming - Part 3' is the game's 'Farming', confirmed by content (the same three objectives, with the first two swapped in order) and by the wiki, whose page for that id is titled 'Farming'. The rest of the line scattered too: Part 1 -> 'Playing the Market', Part 4 -> 'Semiconductor Crisis', Part 2 not yet renamed on the wiki. So 'a - Part 1 in a source name means that quest kept the base name' is NOT a safe rule, check the content.

quests.name: Gunsmith Master - Part 1
quests.lineShattered:
THE GUNSMITH LINE WAS SPLIT IN TWO AND THE SECOND HALF RENUMBERED, and renaming runs in BOTH directions. Parts 1-12 and 15 became weapon names (see Gunsmith - MP-133); parts 13, 14 and 16-21, plus 25, became a new numbered line called GUNSMITH MASTER, and every mapping below was verified word-for-word against the source objective:
  Part 14 -> Master 1 (HK 416A5), Part 13 -> Master 2 (R11 RSASS), note those two are SWAPPED. Part 16 -> Master 3 (DVL-10), 17 -> 4 (AK-102), 18 -> 5 (AKMN), 19 -> 6 (SVDS), 20 -> 7 (M1A), 21 -> 8 (M700 + M1911), 25 -> 13 (PKP).
  And 'Gunsmith - Old Friend's Request' became 'Gunsmith Master - Part 12'. That is a NAMED quest turning into a NUMBERED one, the exact opposite of the 13 numbered-to-named renames in the same original line. So 1.1.0 did not simply move away from numbering.
  The line-scoped content check cannot catch any of this: the game's name is in the 'gunsmith master' line while the source's is in 'gunsmith', so they are never compared. These matches rest on the wiki's page mapping, and the content agreement above is what confirms them.
